set.body: Evidence: semantic GPCA and sparse plus smooth factorization require callers to assemble spaces, identities, charts, capabilities and compiler plans before intent is visible. Acceptance: add narrow safe-default builders for semantic PCA or GMD and joint sparse plus smooth fitting; infer identity geometry and mint internal IDs; expose advanced artifacts through inspectable results; lower to the existing checked core without duplicating semantics; include concise README examples and JVM plus Scala.js equivalence tests.
set.title: Add task-oriented builders over the multivar proof core
